classification_evidence.locator: Title and section 1, especially the paragraphs beginning 'What is artificial intelligence?' and 'This Communication sets out a European initiative on AI'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The communication defines AI and sets out the EU's substantive AI initiative, objectives, investment, socioeconomic, ethical, and legal actions.

classification_evidence.locator: Section 1 paragraph beginning 'These are some of the many examples of what we know AI can do across all sectors', and the objectives immediately below 'This Communication sets out a European initiative on AI'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The text expressly frames AI across all sectors and across the economy, private and public sectors, rather than limiting the communication to one domain.

classification_evidence.locator: Title 'Coordinated Plan on Artificial Intelligence' and sections 1-2, including 'THE EUROPEAN AI STRATEGY' and 'THE COORDINATED PLAN ON AI - OVERVIEW'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The document is expressly an AI plan and sets objectives and actions for AI investment, data, talent, trust, uptake, and coordination.

classification_evidence.locator: Section 1 paragraphs beginning 'By making sense of vast amounts of data' and 'Member States ... and the Commission prepared the plan', which refer to all economic sectors, public services, healthcare, transport and mobility, safety, security, energy, manufacturing, and financial services.
classification_evidence.rationale: The official text expressly spans all economic sectors and public services and enumerates several distinct application domains.

classification_evidence.locator: Title and sections 1-2, especially the paragraphs beginning 'Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential' and 'The purpose of this Communication is to launch a comprehensive piloting phase'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The communication substantively addresses trustworthy, human-centric AI and launches implementation testing of ethical guidance for AI development and use.

classification_evidence.locator: Section 1 opening paragraph, which enumerates healthcare, energy, cars, farming and natural resources, climate, financial risk, manufacturing, fraud, cybersecurity, and law enforcement uses of AI.
classification_evidence.rationale: The opening scope spans numerous public and private domains and is not confined to a single sector.
